svg.title: Binit is ready to type 1.4–3.1× sooner than Bash-it and Oh My Bash
svg.desc: Ready to type in a new shell, 50 plugins: vs Bash-it, 1.4× faster (Binit 22.4 ms · Bash-it 31.2 ms, scored); vs Oh My Bash, 3.1× faster (Binit 22.4 ms · Oh My Bash 69.8 ms, scored); vs a .bashrc sourcing them directly, 1.6× slower (Binit 22.4 ms · .bashrc 14.0 ms, reported); load=wait plugins, vs Bash-it, 1.1× faster (Binit 27.2 ms · Bash-it 31.2 ms, reported); load=wait plugins, vs Oh My Bash, 2.6× faster (Binit 27.2 ms · Oh My Bash 69.8 ms, reported). All 50 plugins loaded: vs Bash-it, 1.3× faster (Binit 33.1 ms · Bash-it 42.4 ms, scored); vs Oh My Bash, 2.7× faster (Binit 33.1 ms · Oh My Bash 88.3 ms, scored); vs a .bashrc sourcing them directly, 1.5× slower (Binit 33.1 ms · .bashrc 22.4 ms, reported); load=wait plugins, vs Bash-it, 1.1× faster (Binit 38.2 ms · Bash-it 42.4 ms, reported); load=wait plugins, vs Oh My Bash, 2.3× faster (Binit 38.2 ms · Oh My Bash 88.3 ms, reported).
